## Checklist

- [ ] It is about DICOM.
- [ ] A library or tool is open source with a license, the entry links to its source code, its README or repository page explains how to install and use it, and it is maintained, or stable and still works.
- [ ] A dataset, hosted tool, learning resource or related list meets its own bar in the guidelines.
- [ ] It sits where the guidelines put it. A library is something you use in your own code, and a tool is something you run.
- [ ] The entry reads `- [Name](link) - Description.`, with one sentence that says what it does, without repeating the name or marketing claims.
- [ ] It is in alphabetical order in Libraries, Tools, Hosted Tools and Related Lists, or at the end of its group in Datasets and Learning Resources.
- [ ] A new section has a line in Contents.
